description: DIRECT lateral-Borel/median test of the deformed (u≠0) Φ_b odd tower — the computation the corpus inferred but never ran. Borel–Padé[2/2] of committed κ̃₁..κ̃₄ at the substrate meridian: (1) on-ray Laplace reproduces Im 𝔙̃_b≈0.0585; (2) lateral sums S_± around the physical ray give |S_+−S_−|≈0 — DIRECTLY confirms single-valued (no Stokes jump on the substrate ray); (3) across-singularity residue gives the tower's Stokes-constant magnitude (anchor-blind, ~2 sig figs). VERDICT scope-(a): the deformed median resummation is anchor-BLIND, cannot supply S's swing — subsumed by the Lean-proved no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing. The swing is the 1/u³ inversion of a smooth N_odd=S·u³ (BarOddLadderShape); its geometric origin (Im 𝔙_q→N_odd) is the open capstone, not a resummation. No c_k; no fit.

data.anchor_invariance_prune: Lean-proved QOU.QBeta.SRigidity.no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing (sorry-free): any anchor-invariant datum g(datum) with datum constant across anchors cannot equal an S that swings. The deformed tower + its Stokes constant are anchor-blind (proton-extracted, blind to 7.9e-9), hence excluded as the swing carrier.
data.verdict: DEFORMED MEDIAN RESUMMATION IS ANCHOR-BLIND (try-1 settled, directly). On-ray reproduces the committed 0.0585 |S|-scale; lateral sums around the physical ray give |S_+−S_−|≈0 — the physical resummation is single-valued (no Stokes jump), now DIRECTLY computed, not inferred. The tower's across-singularity Stokes magnitude is a fixed anchor-blind number. Excluded as the swing carrier by the Lean-proved no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing. The swing is the 1/u³ inversion of a smooth N_odd (BarOddLadderShape); geometric origin (Im 𝔙_q→N_odd) is the open capstone — not a resummation, not a fixed knot's CS. No c_k; no fit.
